breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that applying both an adiabatic (zero flux) and a fixed temperature condition to the same surface (x=0) is contradictory. It resolved this by creating a well-posed problem, applying the fixed temperature T(0)=350 K to one side and moving the adiabatic condition (dT/dx=0) to the other side of the wall (x=L). This is a standard and logical interpretation that creates a solvable problem, aligning with the spirit of the ground truth's suggested correction.
